newsitem.title: USA: Duquesne shuts Beaver Valley, Pa. nukes.
newsitem.headline: Duquesne shuts Beaver Valley, Pa. nukes.

text.p: Duquesne Light Co shut both of its Beaver Valley nuclear power plants, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reported Thursday.
The units, in Shippingport, Pa., have a combined generating capacity of 1,643 megawatts (MW).
Unit one, rated at 810 MW, is currently in hot standby and the adjacent unit number two, rated at 833 MW, is in hot shutdown, the NRC said.
Both units were producing at full power early Wednesday, according to the NRC.
Beaver Valley 1 was tentatively scheduled to shut September 5 for maintenance and refueling.
The company was not immediately available to comment on the cause of the outages or when the units are likely to come back on line.
